title: Blue Max Charters

services.name: Charter Fishing
services.desc: Fishing for salmon and trout on a 38 foot motor yacht is an experience that all can enjoy. 23 years experience and the latest in tackle almost always guarantees success. The method of fishing on Lake Michigan is motor trolling. On the Blue Max we troll with up to 14 rods. The rates are the total charge for the boat, not per person. By US Coast Guard law, only six paying passengers are allowed per charter boat. If you have a group larger than six (which is very common), we'll take care of all the arrangements of getting you as many vessels as your group needs As the boat moves through the water, the captain and customers set tackle to provide an artificial lure to the fish at all potential

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: The rates are the total charge for the boat, not per person. By US Coast Guard law, only six paying passengers are allowed per charter boat. All alone? We put together groups upon request. Many of our customers would like to fish with someone. This year we are featuring an opportunity for those who would prefer to share the boat with others to pay a single person rate of $150 plus tax for a five hour charter or until limit catch. It is still possible to pay for a boat and have the boat completely to yourself at our regular rates. FIREWORKS TRIPS ARE RESERVED WITH DEPOSIT. ALL OTHER CRUISES CALL 2 HOURS BEFORE YOU WOULD LIKE TO GO TO CHECK
